findings.summary: The production spawn does not spawn anything: spawnAgentRun publishes an `agent.run.started.v1` record for a run that was never launched. The mapped R1a role (`dr-worker-code-local` etc.) is only embedded in a payload; nothing in the repo starts a worker for it. Because decideTick treats an in_flight card whose run has state `started` as 'still running' (src/tick.ts:155-158) and no `exited` event can ever arrive for a run with no process, every dispatched card is pinned in in_flight forever, permanently consuming one of the 4 concurrency slots and blocking decideTermination's `drained` condition. Combined with the now-live template switch (TICK_CHANNEL defaults to research:p02-smoke-1dce60 in bin/deep-research-loop.sh:28), the loop will claim up to maxConcurrentWorkers cards and then stall the board for good, while writing irreversible false run-lifecycle facts onto an append-only bus. This is spec §4.1 discipline 8 in its purest form: `agent.run.started` means 'a worker run started' to the reader, and the dispatcher now asserts it without a worker — the very fact the reclaim path depends on is self-manufactured.

The N13 real-machine evidence contradicts the delivered code. The dev-note reports that after the dispatch run (spawns: [{runId: 33793a1b…, spawned: true}]) a subsequent `--run` 'reclaim 回 open，writes 1，spawns 空'. Under the delivered code that is impossible: runChannelWrite reads and writes the same runs channel (`board:agent-runs`, src/tick-run.ts:335-343), so a landed started event for 33793a1b would make the next tick leave the card alone (writes 0, no decisions). Either the started publish never took effect on the real bus — in which case the churn the rework claims to eliminate still occurs — or this N13 section is carried over from the pre-fix attempt and was not re-run against the reworked code. Either way the package's central claim ('下一次 tick 读到 started 便不再 reclaim 该在飞卡，churn 消除') has no valid real-machine evidence.

Spawn now performs irreversible bus writes while retaining the exemption that was justified by it not writing at all. Spec §2 states the budget rule with an explicit premise: '⛔ spawn 本身也要计入写入预算？不计——spawn 不写 bus，但每次 spawn 前的 CAS 计入'. The implementation breaks that premise (spawn POSTs a publish per dispatch) but keeps the exemption, so each `--run` can append up to maxWrites unbudgeted, undeletable messages that `--max-writes` neither counts nor caps. Those appends also land on the shared `board:agent-runs` channel, whereas spec §2 sanctions real-machine writes only on `research:p02-smoke-1dce60`.

Spec §1.2's ⛔ requirement that a `web` card be blocked '并给出明确 rationale' (acceptance N7: 'blocked 且 rationale 非空') is not delivered on the card. WEB_BLOCK_RATIONALE is an exported constant that no production path references: the block decision carries only a `reason` enum, and runWrite's block branch CASes `{status: 'blocked'}` with no rationale, even though ClueV2 has a `rationale?: string | null` field (src/protocol.ts:15). The only rationale assertion (test/tick.test.ts:297-301) checks the constant's length and content against itself, proving nothing about any card — the non-discriminative pattern spec §4.1 disciplines 4 and 7 forbid.
